controls: Four profiles reuse one State: symmetric and ordinary full CSC structures at dimensions2 and3.
Seed every field/attribute with a defined nondefault value; these deliberately stale values never enter Sparse API functions.
Execute exact saved initialization fragment and exact original kind assignments; verify row/column dimensions, pointers, blocksize and all5 attribute fields.
Verify reset/reuse by reseeding the same previously initialized structure before each profile; do not compare object padding.

Fourteen literal-method mock scenarios: no-factor solve refusal; symbolic-only destroy; success-to-success reformation; numeric failure with storage, symbolic-only reference or no resource; success-to-failure; symbolic failure with/without defined resources; repeated PreProcess/Factor/Destroy; matrix replacement/create; zero equations; Implementation/vector destruction.
Mock SDK allocation/refcount ledger refuses cleanup of never-acquired dummy objects and checks old numeric storage/references released before replacement.

limitations: Mock allocations/refcounts verify adapter ownership transitions under defined SDK states; they do not execute or validate private Accelerate constructors, factorization, solve accuracy or mechanics.

Failed owned-symbolic return is a defined mock edge, not a claim that each SDK error allocates. Canonical empty numeric failure has invalid embedded symbolic status and no resources; documented failed numeric states retain valid symbolic state.
ASan/UBSan run only corrected fixture code; leak sanitizer unavailable on this Mac profile, so explicit allocation/refcount and implementation/vector destruction checks are used.
Original zero-row/CSC conversion positive evidence is retained; unchanged fragment does not require executing original defective bounds path.
Excluded iterative and condition-number branches are aborting stubs and are not validated.
purpose: Validate repaired-only SMS initialization and literal adapter resource lifetime using actual SDK types with defined API allocation/refcount mocks.
remaining_gate: Independent review, commit and separate bounded root release of these two repaired-only fixtures; accepted saved results plus independent review required before any runtime build.
scope: Repaired-only actual SDK structure initialization and literal patched adapter lifecycle with defined allocation/refcount mocks. No original faulty code, real SparseFactor/SparseSolve, FEBio runtime/model or numerical accuracy test.
